title: Bounded paired reads: CLI quick start
scenario: S1-S3: Python 3.10+, two owned local HTTP peers and a matching candidate file. This fixture capture does not establish live product parity. See the adjacent operations guide for the manifest schema, production prerequisites and conditional reads (S4).

steps.title: Preview, capture, then inspect before resuming
steps.instruction: Run paired_read.py with --manifest and --candidate for a dry preview. Add --execute --state and --candidate-binary only after the parent run is qualified. For two local peers, add --loopback-test --production with the second loopback origin. The excerpt below is actual output from that CLI sequence.
steps.caption: Two different raw responses were retained. The subsequent --resume was refused because this run had already reached its duration. No production requests were sent.
steps.expected: Inspect terminal, attempts and pending. Duration completion is not a product PASS. Ordinary interruption may resume the unchanged run; terminal errors/duration cannot. Preserve evidence and complete the separate cloud cleanup.
